summary: Maase Inc. furnished a Form 6-K with unaudited condensed combined financial statements of its wholly-owned subsidiary Times Good Limited for the six months ended December 31, 2025. These statements supplement financial information from a June 12, 2026 6-K regarding the Company's acquisition of Times Good. The filing is a routine financial disclosure of a foreign private issuer, providing financials of an acquired subsidiary. It does not announce new deal terms or special-situation activity. The acquisition itself was previously disclosed, and this filing is supplementary, not a standalone event. The contents are incorporated by reference into an existing Form S-8 registration statement. No new deal terms are provided, and the filing does not trigger a special-situation classification.
